answer: The pulse multiplier is published, charged in cipher, and forge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 14 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 4665 identities would post 2853 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
